## Exact endpoint and estimator

This measures public persisted query/query_json **statement-level call-return and
assignment**, not native-only time, end-to-end ingestion/setup or all store latency:
`t0=perf_counter_ns(); result=fn(request); elapsed=perf_counter_ns()-t0`.
**Disposal of the previous result can occur during assignment before stop.**
No preclearing, del, GC suppression or endpoint rewrite was introduced. External
benchmark normalization/bit checks/checksums/logging happen after stop; internal
public guards/validation/DB/native/fetch/conversion/JSON remain inside. Shared
control order does not prove carryover/lifetime/GC effects disappear. Wall time
includes descheduling; no exclusive CPU-time claim.

Each comparison42 process-pairs (2rounds×21),84 fresh sequential processes. Both
first-load orders balance21/21 overall; within a pair the fixed randomized14-control
order is shared. Every process has2warm+3measured sweeps:70 outcomes/42measured.
Total11,760=7,056measured+4,704warmup, all retained. Three technical repetitions
become one process/control median;42 paired ratios are the resampling units.
Seeded20,000-resample pair-unit percentile intervals and both round/load strata
are retained. No7,056-independent-observation inference, min selection, trimming,
old/new pooling or multi-build/multi-host claim. Intervals are descriptive percontrol,
not family-wise/equivalence guarantees. Screen median>1.05, lowerCI>1 and both round
medians>1 is declared investigation triage, not a release SLO. 'Not triggered' is
not no effect/equivalence; note B no-float query's positive interval below the5%screen.
Absolute marginal medians are not the paired ratio. Ratio>1 means reader is slower.
